name: Happy Horse Edit
description: Happy Horse supports advanced video editing through natural language instructions

action.description: Happy Horse supports advanced video editing through natural language instructions
action.name: alibaba/happy-horse/video-edit

audio_setting.description: Audio handling. 'auto': model decides whether to regenerate audio. 'origin': preserve the original audio from the input video.
audio_setting.title: Audio Setting

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the desired edit. Max 2500 characters.
prompt.title: Prompt

seed.description: Seed value for random number generator. Uncheck for reproducible results.
seed.title: Seed

video_url.description: URL of the source video to edit. Formats: MP4, MOV (H.264 recommended). Duration: 3-60 s. Output duration matches the input video, capped at 15 s (longer inputs are truncated to the first 15 s).
video_url.title: Video Url
